name: smwmusic-fire-emblem-mystery-of-the-emblem-holy-war
title: Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem - Holy War
description:
Requested by buggy789.

The map theme for the final chapters of Book 2 of Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem. Suitable for final areas, overworlds, and perhaps castles.

Comes with an option to either play at the original volume or match the channel volume values to the original SPC, the latter of which will be louder due to a difference in master volume between SMW and FE3.
